item.title: Skippa fires back at Sumfest CEO - IRIE FM
item.description: Dancehall deejay Skippa is responding to comments made by Reggae Sumfest CEO Josef Bogdanovich during a recent interview with Anthony Miller.

item.title: NWC implements regulatory measures for Constant Spring Water System in St. Andrew - IRIE FM
item.description: The National Water Commission (NWC) says it will implement regulatory measures for the Constant Spring Water System in St. Andrew effective today. In a statement, NWC noted that despite rainfall experienced over the past several days, water levels at the Hermitage Dam continue to decline and are now approaching the critical threshold at 65%.

item.title: Buju Banton hits back at Wayne Wonder over alleged defamation - IRIE FM
item.description: Buju Banton is giving Wayne Wonder and his wife until Wednesday to retract what he describes as defamatory statements made against him.

item.title: KFTL to extend operating hours following fire to maintain customer service - IRIE FM
item.description: Kingston Freeport Terminal Limited (KFTL) says it will extend operating hours to recover lost time and maintain service commitments to customers following a fire at the terminal earlier today. KFTL’s Corporate Communications Manager, Trudy Belnavis, confirmed that the incident involved a straddle carrier operating in the space.

item.title: OUR calls on academia to find climate resilience utility solutions - IRIE FM
item.description: Director General of the Office of Utilities Regulation (OUR) Ansord Hewitt is calling on the country's academic institutions to help find climate resilience utility solutions. Mr. Hewitt was speaking at the OUR's 12th Annual Director-General’s Stakeholders’ Engagement at the Jamaica Pegasus Hotel in Kingston on Thursday.

item.title: DCS reports continued decline in offender re-admissions to correctional institutions - IRIE FM
item.description: The Department of Correctional Services (DCS) is reporting a continued decline in offender re-admissions to correctional institutions, which it says reflects the impact of its rehabilitation efforts. Last year, the DCS recorded 153 offender readmissions out of 575 total admissions, resulting in a 27% readmission rate.

item.title: Transformation of Manor Park Bus Lay-By underway - IRIE FM
item.description: The long-anticipated transformation of the Manor Park bus lay-by and commercial vending zone in St. Andrew has officially started. The project, being executed through a strong public-private partnership, is led by Member of Parliament for St. Andrew North Central, Delano Seiveright.

item.title: Marine police seize 70 knitted bags containing compressed ganja and associated contraband during operation in Hellshire St. Catherine - IRIE FM
item.description: In a statement, the Constabulary Force said lawmen assigned to the Marine Division, acting on operational intelligence, carried out a targeted search in the community. Police said each of the 70 bags is estimated to weigh between 30 and 50 pounds, representing a substantial quantity of the illicit substance.

item.title: Westmoreland Family Court to resume full operations next week following disruptions due to hurricane Melissa - IRIE FM
item.description: The Court Administration Division said operations are set to resume next Monday March 30, at the original location on Rose Street, in Savanna-la-mar. The resumption follows a period of temporary relocation after the courthouse sustained significant damage from hurricane Melissa, which affected the roofing and other sections of the building.

item.title: JABBEM calls on government to withdraw and revise the Beach Access and Management Policy tabled in parliament last week - IRIE FM
item.description: JABBEM said the policy, as is, reinforces a legacy of colonial and capitalist dispossession which limits Jamaicans' access. The lobby group wants government to create a new policy which restores full, unconditional and inalienable public access to the beach.

item.title: JSE's Group CEO calls for faster progress on Jamaica's renewable energy transition - IRIE FM
item.description: Group Chief Executive Officer of the Jamaica Stock Exchange, Livingstone Morrison, has called for faster progress on Jamaica's renewable energy transition.Mr. Morrison made the appeal in light of the United States-Israeli war on Iran, which has led to restricted access through the Strait of Hormuz, a critical oil choke point.
